title: Inverse Synthesis of Shock Time Series from Shock Response Spectra Using Ensembles of Conditional Variational Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.12820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The shock response spectrum (SRS) characterizes the peak responses of single-degree-of-freedom systems to transient acceleration. Because the mapping from an acceleration time series (waveform) to its SRS is many-to-one, inverse synthesis seeks candidate waveforms consistent with a prescribed spectrum. We extend an earlier conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) framework with a recurrent decoder that predicts multiscale wavelet coefficients and reconstructs waveforms through an inverse discrete wavelet transform. Individual models exhibit limited variability under latent sampling, motivating an ensemble of independently trained models spanning different mother wavelets and decomposition levels. Each member produces a separate candidate waveform for the same target SRS. Evaluation on four held-out benchmark datasets shows lower mean and median spectral errors for the illustrated wavelet model than for the earlier direct time-domain CV

translated_title: 使用条件变分自编码器集成从冲击响应谱逆向合成冲击时间序列
translated_abstract: 冲击响应谱（SRS）表征单自由度系统对瞬态加速度的峰值响应。由于从加速度时间序列（波形）到其冲击响应谱的映射是多对一的，逆向合成旨在寻找与给定谱一致的候选波形。我们扩展了先前的条件变分自编码器（CVAE）框架，采用循环解码器预测多尺度小波系数，并通过逆离散小波变换重构波形。由于单个模型在潜变量采样下表现出的变异性有限，我们构建了由独立训练的模型组成的集成，这些模型涵盖不同的小波母函数和分解层级。每个成员模型为同一目标冲击响应谱生成一个独立的候选波形。在四个留出的基准数据集上的评估表明，所展示的小波模型的平均和中位数谱误差低于先前的直接时域CVAE模型。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于条件变分自编码器集成（涵盖不同小波母函数与分解层级）的逆向合成方法，通过循环解码器预测多尺度小波系数重构波形，为同一目标冲击响应谱生成多个候选冲击波形，其谱误差低于先前的直接时域CVAE模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an inverse synthesis method using ensembles of conditional variational autoencoders spanning different mother wavelets and decomposition levels, where recurrent decoders predict multiscale wavelet coefficients to reconstruct waveforms, generating multiple candidate shock waveforms for a target shock response spectrum with lower spectral errors than direct time-domain CVAE models.
